worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 40,000.00 + interest 1,250.00 = 41,250.00. Federal taxable income = 41,250.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 25,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). D-40 (single): Line 4 federal AGI 41,250.00. Line 5 franchise tax 0.00. Line 6 other additions 0.00 (no other-state municipal interest). Line 7 = 41,250.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 41,250.00. Line 10 0.00 (no Social Security or railroad retirement). Lines 8, 9, 11, 12, 13 0.00. Line 14 Schedule I Calculation B Line 16 0.00. Line 15 total subtractions = 0.00. Line 16 DC AGI = 41,250.00 - 0.00 = 41,250.00. Line 17 standard (same as federal). Line 18 from Schedule S Calculation G-1: line a basic 15,000.00; lines b and d age 65 (born before January 2, 1961): you age 35 (born 1990-09-01) does not count; line f 0; line g 2,000.00 x 0 = 0.00; line h 15,000.00 + 0.00 = 15,000.00. Line 19 DC taxable income = 41,250.00 - 15,000.00 = 26,250.00. Line 20 tax, Calculation I rate schedule as numbers: 4% x 10,000.00 = 400.00 + 6% x 16,250.00 = 975.00; total 1,375.00. (Taxable income is 100,000 or less, so the form reads the tax table: row 26,250-26,299, PDF page 96, gives 1,377; expected keeps the formula figure.) Lines 21-23 credits 0.00; Line 24 = 1,375.00.
accepted_approximations: Tax on taxable income of 100,000 or less comes from the tax tables (50-dollar rows); the projection uses the rate schedule.
